subject: Accelerator pilot credit activation and short extension request
messages:
From: Bethany Cole <bethany@accelerate.co>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Cc: partners@accelerate.co
Date: Tue, 09 May 2028 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Accelerator pilot — request for short extension + top‑up

Hi Rafael,

Quick note from the Accelerate Labs team — our pilot with Redwood hit the internal review hurdle this morning and several product leads asked for an extra 4 weeks to complete a final round of integration tests. We still have active usage and a clear path to expand into two additional product teams, but their consumption will spike in the final validation week.

Could Redwood approve a 30–45 day trial extension and a one‑time voucher top‑up of 75k credits to cover the ramp? The accelerator provides the funds but needs Redwood to activate the voucher and extend the trial window for the cohort so teams can finish the validations.

Attached: accelerator_application.pdf (accelerator intake), usage_snapshot_may.csv (current consumption).

If you need a formal PO or a signed amendment, we can send it — wanted to check feasibility first.

Appreciate any quick help, our demo date is June 12.

—Bethany
Bethany Cole
Head of Partnerships, Accelerate Labs
bethany@accelerate.co | +1 415-555-0192

From: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
To: Bethany Cole <bethany@accelerate.co>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 09 May 2028 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Accelerator pilot — request for short extension + top‑up

Thanks Bethany — and congrats on getting the product leads to the finish line. We can usually accommodate short extensions and partner‑sourced promo credits, but I need to align with Partnerships Finance and Marketplace Ops on how the voucher is provisioned and what guardrails we put on usage.

Marissa — can you confirm whether Finance is OK to allocate a one‑time 75k promo (promo code / account credit) for ACCEL-2028-049 and what approval path you need (PO / signed amendment / partner agreement)?

Jordan — if Finance signs off, can Marketplace Ops provision a voucher with a 60‑day window starting on activation and restrictions to the cohort account IDs? We want to avoid cross‑tenant bleed and keep redemption tied to the accelerator cohort.

Bethany — if helpful I can draft a short amendment and the voucher terms for signature this week. Also linking a draft term sheet I typically use for accelerator credits.

Thanks,
Rafael
Rafael Mendes | Senior GTM Partnerships
Redwood Inference
rafael@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0133

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 10 May 2028 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Accelerator pilot — request for short extension + top‑up

Rafael / Jordan,

Finance is comfortable with a one‑time 75k promo allocation provided we capture: (1) the cohort account IDs that will redeem the voucher, (2) a signed amendment referencing ACCEL-2028-049 and the promo terms, and (3) an expiry window (we recommend 60 days from activation). Please also include a clause capping per‑tenant redemption to prevent a single team from consuming the full allotment.

Jordan — operational notes: we need a merchant‑side promo code that can only be assigned to a list of account IDs (SaaS account GUIDs). If the Marketplace integration cannot restrict to account IDs, we should instead require Accelerate Labs to create separate sub‑accounts per cohort member and tie the voucher to those sub‑accounts.

I attached a short promo_terms_v2.pdf that covers standard liabilities and usage guardrails. If Procurement needs a PO, Bethany can route one to billing@redwood.com and we can fast‑track.

Marissa
Marissa Cole | Partnerships Finance
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

From: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
To: Bethany Cole <bethany@accelerate.co>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 13 May 2028 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Accelerator pilot — request for short extension + top‑up

Bethany — good news: we can approve the request with the following plan.

1) Voucher: one‑time promo credit of 75,000 tokens (promo code ACCEL-2028) will be provisioned. Redemption will be restricted to the cohort account IDs you provide. Per‑account cap: 25,000 tokens.

2) Window: 60 days from activation. We will start the window on first redemption or on an agreed activation date, whichever you prefer.

3) Terms & signature: please review the attached promo_terms_v2.pdf. If acceptable, send back a signed amendment referencing ACCEL-2028-049 or a PO to billing@redwood.com and we’ll provision within 48 hours.

4) Activation link: https://redwood.app/activate?promo=ACCEL2028 (we will only enable the code after we receive the cohort IDs and signed amendment).

Jordan — when you have a moment, please provision the promo code on the marketplace side and confirm whether the account‑ID binding is supported; if not, we will require sub‑account creation per Marissa’s note.

Bethany — let me know your preferred activation date and send the cohort IDs (list of email addresses or account GUIDs). If you want, I’ll draft the amendment and route it for signature this afternoon.

Looking forward to the demo — happy to help on call if the teams want a quick activation walkthrough.

Best,
Rafael

Attachments referenced: promo_terms_v2.pdf, usage_snapshot_may.csv
